about: What every HL7 CDA R2 document modeled on a sample shares. A kind's profile (cda-document.json, cda-ccd.json) extends this one and says what repeats and what follows from what. XML's and HL7 v3's grammar -- namespaces, a URI keeping its scheme, a timestamp keeping its precision and zone, a displayName following its code -- is the reader's. Places are written as the masking tool's CDA config writes paths: from the document's root ('recordTarget/patientRole/patient/name/family'), '//' at any depth, '@name' an attribute.

structural.about: What ties the document together or says how to read a value, never a value anybody generates: template and type ids, the narrative (section 'text', which a reference points into), an id's assigning authority (root), code systems and display names (a displayName follows its code), and the class, mood, type and null-flavor codes HL7 v3 builds a statement from. Never proposed.

qualified.about: Attributes of the same element that say what a value is, by the value's last two steps: an id's extension is a record number or an SSN by its root. Shown on the screen and written into a saved config as 'where'. A URI's scheme (tel:, mailto:) says what it is too; that is CDA's grammar and needs no entry here.

within.about: What an enclosing element says about the places inside it: a place in a section is that section's, by the section's LOINC code (procedures 47519-4, results 30954-2, ...). Shown on the screen and written into a saved config as 'where' (section=47519-4), so a date among the procedures and a date among the allergies take different algorithms.

member.about: Where a place's suggestion can be for the member: the patient's own blocks. The patient's guardian and birthplace and the provider organization sit inside them and are somebody else's; so is everyone outside them (authors, performers, the custodian).

levels.about: Places that are an enclosing unit's, by where they are: everything under recordTarget is the member's, filled from the member's record, so all of a member's documents name the same person. Every other place is the document's own, filled from its claim.

places.about: What a place holds, when a config's algorithm name does not say, wherever it is. First fitting wins: the SSN's root before any id. The document's dates are its encounter's: the claim's service date (a timestamp keeps the sample's time of day and zone).

checks.about: What a written document is checked for: the header elements CDA R2 requires of every ClinicalDocument, and value sets for coded places (HL7 AdministrativeGender, Confidentiality).

codes.about: Where HL7 v3 codes a value the store codes otherwise: the store's value -> HL7's, else 'default'; 'display' is the displayName written with it. Without 'map' the value is the code as it is; 'systems' is the code system written with it, the first whose 'match' the code fits (a claim's procedure code is HCPCS when it starts with a letter, else CPT).
